candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] CLG: The development of an innovative device (CLG) consisting of an aqueous gel based on hyaluronic acid and commercially available (Belotero)

source_quote.quote: Isolation and Characterization of Cancer Cells (CTC)-CXCR4+ Circulating in Belotero Loaded With CXCL12

biomarkers.biomarker_other: epithelial-mesenchymal markers (EPCAM, SNAIL, VIMENTIN, N-CADHERIN, E-CADHERIN)

source_quote.quote: Expression analysis of Epithelium-Mesenchymal Markers (EPCAM, SNAIL, VIMENTIN, N-CADERIN, E-CADERIN) will be performed using Real-Time PCR.

coder_notes: Glioblastoma named only in the official title as one of several solid tumours; the study is an in vitro CTC-capture device test (hyaluronic acid gel loaded with CXCL12), not an antitumour drug. CXCL12 is a component of the device, not a registered drug intervention, so no agents listed.
